messages:
jake (Design): dropping a quick mock for the latency panel — compact row + expandable detail. emphasis: p95 prominence, small heatstripe, and a tiny sampling control. figma: https://figma.redwood/latency-panel-mini

maria (Product): looks promising. main ask: make p95 obvious without crowding mobile. the heatstripe should hint hotspots but not be noisy.

sam (Eng-Frontend): implementation note: micro-heatstripe can be a single-row canvas; lazy-load full heatmap when expanded. prefer single p95 line + p99 dot to save render cost.

anya (A11y): a11y flags: sample badge needs aria-label, heatstripe must have table fallback, and keyboard focus must expose numeric values. ensure color choices are colorblind-friendly.

li (Eng-ML): backend will supply fields: sample_rate, sample_estimate (range), sample_count. also can add sample_confidence boolean. UI can hide p99 if sample_count < 200.

katie (PM): copy decision: compact badge text = icon only with tooltip "Sampling: auto (~10%)"; expanded shows full label and microcopy: "Lower sampling reduces cost but may miss rare spikes."

jake (Design): agree on icon-only for compact. add helper text when sample_estimate < 5%: "Low sample 12 p99 may be unreliable." small, muted.

sam (Eng-Frontend): will implement icon, tooltip, lazy-load heatmap behind feature flag `heatmap_v2`. also will throttle hover tooltips to avoid jank.

anya (A11y): tooltip must use aria-describedby. when p99 hidden, announce via aria-live: "P99 hidden due to low sample size."

maria (Product): rollout plan: internal QA -> SRE beta -> gradual org rollout. metrics: expand rate, sampling overrides, p99 visibility incidents.

deploy-bot: preview: https://staging.redwood/preview/latency-panel/1765465000  feature_flag=heatmap_v2

jake (Design): thanks all — I'll refine spacing for mobile and send updated figma by EOD Thursday. anya, can you draft the a11y microcopy?

anya (A11y): on it. will post copy + checklist here when ready.
